decisions: The ratchet is fixed in workbench/pane_qt.py, where a pane counts every face shown or not (content_minimum): pane_qt.remeasure invalidates and activates the layout of every widget out of sight under a pane's content, innermost first, whenever the pane's size key changes (a new interface size); and the key that decides whether the pane asks the window again now carries the pane's least width, so a need that drops later is seen. Cause, measured: Context's object view (object_context_qt.View, a SetMinimumSize body inside a hidden face) kept 284 px at 14 pt after 28 pt (151 fresh), because Qt activates a layout only when its widget is visible. The first layout after a size change can still use the old need until the next align (the 500 ms tick or the align queued on the font change).

Step 14 of check_finder_ui asserts at 28 pt one width, equal to the desk's, wider than at 14 pt, and the five parts; not wider than at 20 pt, because in that window the workspace floor caps the panes at 28 pt (444 < 459). The first run of the corrected check failed on exactly that, so the assertion was narrowed to what the retired frame check asserted at 28 pt, and the return to 14 pt is asserted as before.

Frame step 04 (F11 round trip keeps both column widths) is folded into check_finder_ui step 14; frame step 05 (six tabs leave the tab strip at one height) is not folded: it is named in docs/WINDOW_CHECKS.md as a gap with its reason (its six tabs came from the retired journey through the cat; qt_app._steady_tab_strip unchanged since 0.4; nothing measures it now).

The Kasandra window-check pass is documented, not added to --ui: docs/WINDOW_CHECKS.md says whoever cuts a release runs --ui a second time with GRAPHITE_APPEARANCE=kasandra before cutting it, because both looks in --ui would double about six minutes against the road's 15-minute aim.

Run folders: rather than edit 21 scripts, tools/check_hatch.ui_checks gives each check a TMPDIR of its own (tempfile.TemporaryDirectory) and removes it when the check ends; mkdtemp in every script honours it. A script run by hand outside the gate still leaves its folder.
ui_check_lists takes an entry's file as its first word (for python -m, the module's file), so an on-demand entry may carry arguments.
Zero-width spaces in test_whole_words are written as \u200b (6 occurrences).

release_note: The window checks can be believed again. Seven that measured a desk Graphite no longer has were retired, each with its reason in docs/WINDOW_CHECKS.md; the twelve that had been left outside the release check were brought up to date; and all twenty-two now run in the release check and pass in both looks. Running them in the Kasandra look found two words cut by her wider letters (the Date Modified title in the List, a long folder name on a Today card), both fixed. Review found an older fault: after the interface size went up to 28 pt and back, both panes stayed wider until Graphite was restarted; they now come back to their width. The menu toggle "Pleasantries in script", which changed nothing on screen, is gone.
